title: Discography questions: 1924 Paramount, Black Swan 1921, Elmer Chambers
summary: Albertson reads names of singers and sessions; Scott corrects dates and says Chambers preceded him with Henderson.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Now, I believe you made a couple of records with Maureen.
Yeah, way back there. I think I did.
I think you were on Paramount October '24.
Oh, that must have been before I went with Fletcher.
Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, before I went with Fletcher.
I just want to read some of the names of people that you are believed to have recorded with.
Yeah, well, I was talking about my musical experiences in the bands. And that --
Faye Barnes. Do you remember her?
Oh, I knew Gladys, yeah. Yeah, I knew Gladys.
Yeah, looks like you recorded with her.
No -- I've heard of them, but I don't believe I recorded with her.
Now, you were listed as being on the very first record that Fletcher Henderson made, his very first record, with the Black Swan Company, the company that Harry Pace and --
How could they get me there? I wasn't with Fletcher in '21. No, there's a mistake there someplace. '21.
'21, it says. Now, it could have been they made a mistake. It is possible it was Elmo Chambers.
It could have been. Chambers, Chambers. Chambers, he was with Fletcher before me.
So you didn't go with Fletcher until -- what, '23?
